RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Native weaponcraft I
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each different native weaponcraft license held by the actual crafter adds one native Odyssey trait to a newly crafted supported gun, for one, two or three traits. Duplicates add no slots. Compatible passive traits are randomly chosen once and saved. Preserves quality and combines with the separate damage, cooldown and accuracy licenses. Supports revolvers, bolt-action rifles, chain shotguns, heavy SMGs, LMGs, assault/sniper/charge rifles, miniguns and charge lances. Existing items and native unique weapons are excluded. Requires Odyssey.
